blocks.text: With the Analyze Incoming Payments (F5588) app, you can monitor and analyze incoming payments to optimize clarification processes and team workload.
You can use this app to regularly do the following:

- Analyze how many payments have been clarified manually within a given period.
- Analyze the effectiveness of the automated clarification process provided by the standard.

Note: If you have licensed and are using SAP Cash Application, add-on for contract accounting , you can regularly validate the effectiveness of the applied machine learning to the clarification process.
You display the data per company code. You can refine the filter criteria as required by choosing Adapt Filters to include, for example, the posting date, and lot type.
The app analyzes payment lots, credit lots, and check lots, and displays an overview of which amount and number of payments in a payment lot has been cleared automatically or manually.

Note: If you are using SAP Cash Application, add-on for contract accounting , the app analyzes payment lots, credit lots, and check lots, and displays an overview of which amount and number of payments in a payment lot has been cleared using machine learning.
You can display the data by using the following view options:

- The Chart View shows all payment lots matching the filter criteria. The default dimension is Lot . The default measures are Payments in Clarification , Payments Posted Automatically , Payments Posted Manually , and, if you are using SAP Cash Application, add-on for contract accounting , Payments Posted Using Cash App .
- The Table View lists more details per payment lot than the Chart View , including the total number of payments in clarification, the total number of items in lots, and the total payment amount in the last row of the table.
You can combine the table and chart view in a single display.
For each view, you can change chart, dimensions, and measures in the Settings dialog. You change the display by selecting a chart type in combination with a dimension and measures.
Example: You group payments by house bank or origin of the lot.
The details view of individual payment lots shows various statistics, such as the following:

- Payment usage within a payment lot
- Duration of clarification activities
- Level of automation within one payment lot
Note: If you are using SAP Cash Application, add-on for contract accounting , the details view of individual payment lots shows the proposal rate.

Analyze Incoming Payments
With the Analyze Incoming Payments (F5588) app, you can monitor and analyze incoming payments to optimize clarification processes and team workload.
Key Features
You can use this app to regularly do the following:
- Analyze how many payments have been clarified manually within a given period.
- Analyze the effectiveness of the automated clarification process provided by the standard.
Note: If you have licensed and are using SAP Cash Application, add-on for contract accounting , you can regularly validate the effectiveness of the applied machine learning to the clarification process.

The app analyzes payment lots, credit lots, and check lots, and displays an overview of which amount and number of payments in a payment lot has been cleared automatically or manually.
Note: If you are using SAP Cash Application, add-on for contract accounting , the app analyzes payment lots, credit lots, and check lots, and displays an overview of which amount and number of payments in a payment lot has been cleared using machine learning.
Views
You can display the data by using the following view options:
- The Chart View shows all payment lots matching the filter criteria. The default dimension is Lot . The default measures are Payments in Clarification , Payments Posted Automatically , Payments Posted Manually , and, if you are using SAP Cash Application, add-on for contract accounting , Payments Posted Using Cash App .

You can combine the table and chart view in a single display.
For each view, you can change chart, dimensions, and measures in the Settings dialog. You change the display by selecting a chart type in combination with a dimension and measures.
Example: You group payments by house bank or origin of the lot.
Details View
The details view of individual payment lots shows various statistics, such as the following:
- Payment usage within a payment lot
- Duration of clarification activities
- Level of automation within one payment lot
Note: If you are using SAP Cash Application, add-on for contract accounting , the details view of individual payment lots shows the proposal rate.

To display the total payment amount in relation to the open payment amount in a lot, select the following:

- Dimension : Lot
